appName: F1 World Circuit Racing : VR Edition
displayName: F1 World Circuit Racing : VR Edition
display_name: F1 World Circuit Racing : VR Edition
display_long_description:
Step into the cockpit and feel the thrill of Formula racing in Virtual Reality.

F1 World Circuit Racing: VR Edition is a high-speed VR racing experience designed for Meta Quest, focused on immersion, precision, and atmospheric racing. Take control of a powerful formula-style car and push your limits on a detailed racing circuit.

 TRUE VR IMMERSION

Drive from a first-person cockpit view and experience racing like never before. Look into corners, judge distance, and react instantly with smooth, responsive VR controls.

DYNAMIC WEATHER CONDITIONS

Race in changing environments that transform the driving experience:

Sunny – Clear visibility, perfect racing conditions
Sunset – Dramatic lighting and intense atmosphere
Rainy – Wet surfaces that challenge your control and precision

Each condition adds a new layer of difficulty and realism.
 HIGH-SPEED, SKILL-BASED RACING
Push your car to the limit with:

Responsive handling
Smooth acceleration and braking
A strong sense of speed built for VR

Master the track by improving your racing line and reaction time.

 DESIGNED FOR META QUEST

Built for performance and comfort:

Optimized VR gameplay
Intuitive controls
Smooth and immersive experience

MASTER EVERY CONDITION
It’s not just about speed — it’s about control.

F1 World Circuit Racing: VR Edition — Adapt to the Track. Dominate the Drive.
